headline: Radhika Jeweltech shareholders approve all resolutions at 10th AGM
hook: Routine approvals at Radhika Jeweltech AGM
summary: Shareholders of Radhika Jeweltech have approved all resolutions presented at the company's 10th Annual General Meeting. The voting outcomes cover standard procedural corporate business items. For an Indian retail investor holding the stock, this signifies uninterrupted routine corporate governance.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance cleared, no immediate impact on share price.
